metadata.description: Deployment location for all resources.
Target environment name. Only dev and prod are supported.
Optional tags shared by all deployed resources.
Optional container image URI override. By default azd deploy updates the app with the image it builds and pushes to the provisioned registry.
Service name as defined in azure.yaml. During the NAT cutover this stays distinct from the legacy app so azd deploy targets the new Container App unambiguously.
Set to true to provision the Microsoft Entra ID app registration via the Graph Bicep extension.
Display name used for the Microsoft Entra ID app registration when deployEntraAppRegistration is true.

entraAppRegistrationDescription.defaultValue: Multi-tenant Microsoft Entra ID app registration for the fantasy-cards-generator web app.

metadata.description: Description used for the Microsoft Entra ID app registration when deployEntraAppRegistration is true.
Local-development OIDC redirect URI to register when deployEntraAppRegistration is true.
Path appended to the deployed Container Apps URL to form the production OIDC redirect URI.
Path appended to the deployed Container Apps URL to form the production OIDC post-logout redirect URI.
Legacy Cosmos firewall IP rule to retain temporarily during parallel cutover. Clear this after the NAT-backed environment passes smoke tests.
Session cookie signing secret stored in Key Vault and mirrored into the Container App secret set (APP_SESSION_SECRET_KEY). Set via `azd env set APP_SESSION_SECRET_KEY <value>` before provisioning.

Microsoft Entra ID client secret stored in Key Vault and mirrored into the Container App secret set (ENTRA_CLIENT_SECRET). Populated automatically by hooks/gen_client_secret.sh when deployEntraAppRegistration=true.
Cosmos DB SQL database name for application data.
Cosmos DB SQL container name for persisted card documents.
Blob container name for persisted card assets.
Azure AI Foundry project name for the current environment.
Azure AI Foundry project display name for the current environment.
Microsoft Entra principal type running the deployment. Supplied by azd through AZURE_PRINCIPAL_TYPE for ARM role assignments.
Azure AI Foundry deployment name for the text model.
Azure AI Foundry model name for text generation.
Azure AI Foundry model version for text generation. Verify against the live catalog before deployment.
Azure AI Foundry SKU for the text deployment. Verify against regional quota availability before deployment.
Azure AI Foundry capacity units for the text deployment. Verify against live quota before deployment.
Azure AI Foundry deployment name for the image model.
Azure AI Foundry model name for image generation.
Azure AI Foundry model version for image generation. Verify against the live catalog before deployment.
Azure AI Foundry SKU for the image deployment. Verify against regional quota availability before deployment.
Azure AI Foundry capacity units for the image deployment. Verify against live quota before deployment.
AI orchestration mode for the app runtime.
Persistence mode for the app runtime.
Moderation service for the app runtime.
Moderation policy name for the app runtime.
Per-user request limit for generation endpoints.
Per-user rate-limit window in seconds.
Per-IP request limit for generation endpoints.
Per-IP rate-limit window in seconds.
Trusted reverse-proxy hops for request IP extraction. Keep 0 for direct app access; use 1 behind Azure Container Apps ingress so only the ACA rightmost appended X-Forwarded-For hop is trusted.
Maximum retries for retryable upstream dependencies.
Maximum image retries. Keep zero because an image request may complete after the client times out.
Base backoff in seconds between retry attempts.
Text generation timeout in seconds.
Image generation timeout in seconds.
Overall request timeout in seconds.
Sanitized audit retention in days.
Requested image size for artwork generation.

Address prefix for the private endpoint subnet.
NAT Gateway name.
Static public IP resource name used by the NAT Gateway.
Optional tags shared by network resources.

Container Apps environment name.
Log Analytics workspace customer ID for Container Apps logging.
Log Analytics workspace shared key for Container Apps logging.
Delegated subnet resource ID used for workload-profile Container Apps VNet integration.
Optional tags shared by Container Apps resources.
Unique app registration name and display name.
Tenant-unique slug used for the Entra app registration uniqueName.

metadata.description: Deployment location for Container Apps resources.
Resource ID of the Container Apps managed environment the app runs in.
Container App name.
Container image used by the web app.
Azure Container Registry login server used by the web app image.
Managed identity resource ID used by Container Apps to pull from the registry.
Service name as defined in azure.yaml.
Application Insights connection string used by the app foundation.
Key Vault URI injected in the web app environment.
Session cookie signing secret injected into the Container App. Empty skips creating the secret.
Microsoft Entra ID client secret injected into the Container App. Empty skips creating the secret.
Microsoft Entra ID application (client) ID injected as ENTRA_CLIENT_ID. Empty when Entra app registration is disabled.
Deployed OIDC redirect URI injected as ENTRA_REDIRECT_URI. Empty when Entra app registration is disabled.
Deployed post-logout redirect URI injected as ENTRA_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URI. Empty when Entra app registration is disabled.
AI orchestration mode injected as AI_MODE.
Persistence mode injected as PERSISTENCE_MODE.
Azure AI Foundry endpoint injected as FOUNDRY_ENDPOINT.
Azure AI Foundry API version injected as FOUNDRY_API_VERSION.
Azure AI Foundry text deployment injected as FOUNDRY_TEXT_DEPLOYMENT.
Azure AI Foundry image deployment injected as FOUNDRY_IMAGE_DEPLOYMENT.
Cosmos DB endpoint injected as COSMOS_ENDPOINT.
Cosmos DB database name injected as COSMOS_DATABASE_NAME.
Cosmos DB container name injected as COSMOS_CONTAINER_NAME.
Blob endpoint injected as BLOB_ENDPOINT.
Blob container name injected as BLOB_CONTAINER_NAME.
Moderation service injected as MODERATION_SERVICE.
Moderation policy name injected as MODERATION_POLICY_NAME.
Per-user request limit injected as RATE_LIMIT_USER_REQUESTS.
Per-user rate-limit window injected as RATE_LIMIT_USER_WINDOW_SECONDS.
Per-IP request limit injected as RATE_LIMIT_IP_REQUESTS.
Per-IP rate-limit window injected as RATE_LIMIT_IP_WINDOW_SECONDS.
Trusted reverse-proxy hops injected as TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS. Azure Container Apps ingress appends the trustworthy client IP on the rightmost X-Forwarded-For hop.
Maximum upstream retries injected as UPSTREAM_MAX_RETRIES.
Maximum image retries injected as IMAGE_MAX_RETRIES.
Base backoff seconds injected as UPSTREAM_BASE_BACKOFF_SECONDS.
Text generation timeout injected as TEXT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
Image generation timeout injected as IMAGE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
Overall request timeout injected as OVERALL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
Sanitized audit retention in days injected as AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS.
Requested image size injected as IMAGE_SIZE.
Optional tags shared by Container Apps resources.
